acquisition method: Both unfractionated and fractionated tumor lysate digests were analyzed using a Q-Exactive, using top10 data-dependent approach.
alkylation reagent: alkylated using 40 mM iodoacetamide (30 min, kept dark at room temperature)
alkylation concentration: alkylated using 40 mM iodoacetamide (30 min, kept dark at room temperature)
cleavage agent: The samples were then digested with sequencing grade trypsin (Promega, Madison, WI)
collision energy: fragmented in the HCD collision cell with normalized collision energy of 30%
fractionation method: Strong cation exchange chromatography was performed using Microspin columns
fragmentation method: fragmented in the HCD collision cell
instrument: Both unfractionated and fractionated tumor lysate digests were analyzed using a Q-Exactive
labeling: rigorous quantification was not performed here
reduction reagent: A fixed amount (150 μg) of protein were reduced with 10 mM DTT (1 h at 37°C)
reduction concentration: A fixed amount (150 μg) of protein were reduced with 10 mM DTT (1 h at 37°C)
